2021 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L Leather, Stow n Go & Adaptive Cruise

This 2021 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L is a versatile family minivan with premium comfort, flexible seating, and an impressive list of driver-assistance technology. Finished in Luxury White Pearl-Coat with a Black/Alloy interior and McKinley leather perforated bucket seats, its powered by a 3.6L V6 paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission.

Stow n Go Versatility

One of the Pacificas biggest advantages is its flexible interior. This Touring L features second- and third-row Stow n Go seating with Easy-Tilt, making it easy to transition from carrying passengers to hauling larger cargo.

Comfort and convenience features include:

McKinley Leather Perforated Bucket Seats
2nd & 3rd-Row Stow n Go Seats
Heated Front Seats
Heated Steering Wheel
8-Way Power Driver Seat
Driver-Seat Memory
2nd & 3rd-Row Window Shades
Three-Zone Automatic Climate Control
Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror
Floor Console with Covered Storage
10.1-Inch Uconnect 5

The Pacifica features Uconnect 5 with a 10.1-inch touchscreen, providing an easy-to-use centerpiece for entertainment and connectivity.

Technology includes:

10.1-Inch Uconnect 5 Display
Apple CarPlay®
Android Auto™
Bluetooth® Hands-Free Phone & Audio
SiriusXM® Capability
Remote Start
Proximity Entry for All Doors
Push-Button Start
Power Sliding Doors & Power Liftgate

Family-friendly convenience continues outside with dual power sliding doors and a power liftgate. The Pacifica also features LED lighting and a versatile Chrome Stow n Place roof rack.

Exterior highlights include:

Power Sliding Doors
Power Liftgate
Bi-Function LED Projector Headlamps
LED Fog Lamps
LED Taillamps
17-Inch Aluminum Wheels
Chrome Stow n Place® Roof Rack
Heated Exterior Mirrors with Supplemental Turn Signals
Adaptive Cruise & Advanced Safety

This Pacifica Touring L is particularly well equipped with active safety and driver-assistance features, including Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go.

Safety technology includes:

Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop & Go
Blind-Spot Monitoring
Rear Cross-Path Detection
Full-Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus
Pedestrian Emergency Braking
Lane Departure Warning Plus
ParkSense® Rear Park Assist with Stop
ParkView® Rear Backup Camera
Advanced Brake Assist
Rain-Sensing Windshield Wipers
Electronic Stability Control
Interior Protection Package

It was also originally equipped with the $680 Mopar Interior Protection package, adding all-weather cargo and Stow n Go floor mats, bright door sills, a cargo-area liner, and rear cargo-bin Stow n Go storage.

22 MPG Combined

The original EPA rating is 22 MPG combined, with 19 MPG city and 28 MPG highwaysolid efficiency considering the Pacificas passenger and cargo capacity.

Experience the Chevrolet of Naperville Difference

Take this used 2021 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L for a drive on our exclusive 9-acre Chevrolet of Naperville Test Track and experience its smooth V6 performance, comfortable ride, and family-friendly versatility.

You'll work with one of our professional non-commissioned sales specialists, providing a straightforward, pressure-free shopping experience focused on finding the right vehicle for you.

With leather seating, Stow n Go, heated seats, a heated steering wheel, 10.1-inch Uconnect touchscreen, power sliding doors, power liftgate, Adaptive Cruise Control, Blind-Spot Monitoring, and three-zone climate control, this Pacifica Touring L is exceptionally well equipped for daily driving, road trips, and everything a busy family can throw at it.

Introducing this 2012 Honda Odyssey Touring, a family minivan built for comfort, practicality, and dependable performance on every journey.

- Dual-zone front air conditioning with rear air conditioning
- Heated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Power moonroof for natural light and fresh air
- Navigation system with rear parking camera
- DVD audio entertainment system with XM Radio
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Split folding second and third row seating with reclining third row
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory positioning
- HomeLink garage door transmitter

- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- 18-inch alloy wheels
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry

This Odyssey is finished in silver and equipped with a 3.5-liter V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering an estimated 19 MPG in city driving and 28 MPG on the highway. The front-wheel drive configuration provides confident handling, while the four-wheel disc braking system with ABS ensures reliable stopping power.

The cabin showcases thoughtful design with power-adjustable front seats, allowing both driver and passenger to find their ideal position. The leather shift knob adds a refined touch, while the overhead console keeps essentials within reach. Climate control features including automatic temperature adjustment and rear air conditioning ensure passenger comfort throughout the vehicle. Entertainment options include an AM/FM radio, DVD audio system, XM Radio capability, and rear audio controls for back-seat viewers.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side-impact airbags, front anti-roll bar, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. The electronic stability control works in concert with traction control to maintain stability under varying road conditions. The rear parking camera assists with backing maneuvers, while the exterior parking camera provides valuable visibility when needed.

Practicality defines this minivan's appeal. The power liftgate simplifies loading, while the split-folding rear seating configuration adapts to your cargo needs. Speed-sensing wipers adjust automatically to weather conditions, and the rear window wiper handles inclement weather with ease. Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry add convenience to daily operation.

This 2012 Honda Odyssey Touring represents the balance of functionality and comfort that today's families demand. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this minivan's capabilities firsthand.

Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip, while the four-wheel disc brake setup provides reliable stopping power. The low tire pressure warning system and exterior parking camera add extra layers of awareness.

The A5 Sportback delivers the best of worlds by combining the styling of the A5 coupe and the practicality of a four-door hatchback. No one ever said sexy can't also be practical, and the 2021 Audi A5 Sportback blends the best of what we love about the A4 sedan and the A5 coupe and adds a voluminous hatchback cargo hold hidden under its stylish fastback roofline. It even earns a spot on our Editors' Choice list. This athletic four-door competes with other similarly-styled sedans such as the BMW 4-series Gran Coupe and the Kia Stinger, and brings Audi's tech-forward approach and simple-yet-chic interior design. The base Premium model now comes standard with wireless Apple CarPlay connectivity, lane-departure warning, and an integrated toll-road transponder, that car's optional Convenience package now includes a heated steering wheel and front and rear parking sensors. The mid-range Premium Plus gains a host of standard driver-assistance features. The A5 Sportback is composed, confident, and easy to drive fast through corners, it's everything a modern sport sedan should be. Its agility belies its comfort, too: potholes and broken pavement do little to upset it. The well-weighted steering feels natural in the driver's hands, and the front tires respond immediately to inputs, making this Audi a joy to pilot on twisty tarmac. All A5 Sportback models come well equipped with luxury necessities such as power front seats, leather upholstery, a panoramic sunroof, ambient interior lighting, and three-zone automatic climate control. A hatchback in disguise, the A5 Sportback's sloping rear roofline hides a power-operated liftgate and a large cargo hold, making it far more practical than the Audi A4 sedan or the A5 coupe and convertible. Audi's MMI is one of the most pleasing-to-use infotainment systems among premium brands. It's made even better by the A5 Sportback's optionaland highly recommended, 12.3-inch Virtual Cockpit digital gauge display. All models come with a 10.1-inch infotainment touchscreen display that can also be controlled by a clickwheel mounted on the console between the driver and the front-seat passenger. Audi's MMI interface is easy to use while on the go, but Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration is standard if users prefer to interact directly with their smartphones instead.

The cabin reflects the EX-L's attention to detail with leather-trimmed seating surfaces, a leather steering wheel, and a leather shift knob that communicate sophistication with every interaction. Heated front seats and heated mirrors ensure comfort during colder months, while the moonroof opens your world to natural light and fresh air. The dual-climate control system allows driver and passenger to set independent temperature preferences, so everyone stays comfortable regardless of conditions.

Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, keeping you linked to your devices while maintaining focus on the road. The 180-watt audio system with eight speakers delivers clear, balanced sound for your daily commute or longer journeys. An illuminated entry system and front reading lights add convenience and safety as you approach and enter the vehicle.

Safety features work proactively to protect you and your passengers. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow reduces driver fatigue in traffic while maintaining safe distances. Lane Keeping Assist System provides active guidance to help keep you centered in your lane, while the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles outside your primary view. A backup camera makes parking and reversing more confident and secure.

The EX-L combines practicality with thoughtful engineering—power-adjustable driver seat, power windows, remote keyless entry, and telescoping steering wheel all adjust to your preference. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo or passengers, and the trip computer monitors your efficiency metrics.

With one owner on the Carfax report, this Civic comes with the confidence of a well-maintained, single-owner history. The 1.5L four-cylinder engine delivers 31 city and 39 highway MPG, balancing efficiency with everyday capability. Come experience how this Civic's blend of comfort, technology, and reliability can serve your driving needs.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. The exterior presents a clean blue finish with an integrated spoiler that complements the vehicle's aerodynamic design. Heated and power door mirrors with integrated turn signals enhance visibility and safety. The 15-inch alloy wheels provide a refined appearance while supporting the vehicle's efficient handling characteristics.

This Prius comes equipped with practical features that enhance daily ownership. The 5-piece carpet floor mat and cargo mat protect your interior from dirt and wear. The overhead console offers additional storage, and the front center armrest with storage provides a convenient place for personal items.

The nice thing about these having been around for so long, and us having had so many of them and gotten burned on 1 or 2, is that we've done the failing for you so you can have the success. With that said, this one is good and healthy, and it appears to have been owned by a couple of small, neat people who barely sat inn the seats and barely touched anything. The interior is great compared to others we've seen. The exterior is pretty standard 11 year old SoCal (which is so much better than 11 year old Tucson, sorry Tucson, no offense). The suspension is still nice and tight and doesn't seem to have any bad bushings. Alignment is good. Brakes are good. And it goes like a little tiny bat out of tiny hell with its instant torque electric motor and 24kwh battery. 70 miles on a charge around town in the dead of summer. An easy 80 miles in winter. Fits either your stuff or your friends, probably not both. Can charge on a Level 1 charger from 20%-80% in 10 hours, or a Level 2 in 2.5 hours. Not a roadtrip car.

But just look at it. How can you not be romantic about cars.

This example is equipped with a panoramic sunroof, leather seats, premium audio, navigation, sunroof(s), and a backup camera. Its exterior follows the Golf's familiar five-door shape, with clean body lines, a rear liftgate, and compact proportions that make it easy to place in traffic and in parking spaces. The diesel badging identifies the powertrain, and the hatchback body style provides a useful rear opening without adding unnecessary visual complexity.

This interior uses leather upholstery and a driver-focused layout that is typical of the Golf line. The front seating position is arranged for clear visibility to the road ahead, and the cabin materials are presented in a manner consistent with Volkswagen's higher-trim compact cars. The cabin does not rely on excess ornamentation, and the trim selection keeps attention on the fit, finish, and included amenities.

This Volkswagen includes premium audio and navigation, both integrated into the dash for regular use. The display and control interfaces are positioned within the driver's reach, and the system layout supports common in-car functions without requiring unnecessary distraction from the road. The backup camera is part of the equipment list and provides rearward viewing assistance when reversing. The Golf platform is known for balanced road manners, and this diesel version is suited to steady highway travel as well as routine city driving. The turbo-diesel character is part of the vehicle's identity, and the driveline is intended to deliver usable torque in normal conditions without requiring constant high engine speeds.

This 2015 Golf TDI SEL also benefits from the practical shape of the cargo area, which is accessed through the rear hatch and can accommodate everyday items with the rear seat in place. The compact footprint makes the car manageable in tight spaces, while the five-door format keeps entry and exit simple for occupants. The equipment set listed here is centered on comfort, convenience, and visibility, with the panoramic glass roof, leather trim, audio system, navigation, and camera working together as part of the vehicle's content. This example presents those items plainly, with the Golf's familiar utility and diesel efficiency forming the basis of its appeal.

This 2015 Nissan Versa Note S Plus offers practical transportation with a focus on efficiency and reliability for your daily driving needs.

- 1.6L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V engine with CVT transmission
- Front-wheel drive
- Air conditioning
- Power steering
- AM/FM/CD audio system with steering wheel mounted controls
- Rear window defroster
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- ABS brakes with Brake Assist
- Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- Tilt steering wheel
- Trip computer
- 15" steel wheels with full wheel covers

This white compact hatchback delivers strong fuel economy with an EPA-estimated 31 mpg in the city and 40 mpg on the highway. The CVT transmission with Xtronic technology provides smooth acceleration while maximizing efficiency on any road condition. Whether navigating congested urban streets or cruising on the highway, this vehicle responds predictably with its front-wheel-drive platform and independent suspension.

Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin with front bucket seats and cloth upholstery designed for comfort during your commute. The split folding rear seat expands your cargo versatility when you need to transport larger items. Convenient features like the tilt steering wheel, rear window wiper, and trip computer help you stay organized and in control.

Safety is integrated throughout this model with multiple airbags, including dual front impact and side-impact protection. Electronic Stability Control works with traction control to help maintain your grip on varied road surfaces, while speed-sensing steering adjusts to different driving speeds. The ABS braking system with Brake Assist provides confident stopping power.

The audio system keeps you connected with AM/FM and CD capability, plus steering wheel-mounted controls that let you adjust volume and station selection without taking your hands off the wheel. The rear window defroster clears visibility in all weather conditions, and body-color bumpers maintain a cohesive appearance.

Standard convenience items include floor and cargo mats to protect your interior, splash guards to defend against road debris, and power door mirrors for enhanced visibility. The occupant sensing airbag system intelligently deploys protection based on seat occupancy.

This 2015 Versa Note S Plus combines everyday practicality with a proven track record of dependable performance. With solid fuel economy, sensible safety features, and a spacious hatchback design, it's ready to serve your transportation needs reliably.

This 2019 Chevrolet Spark ACTIV brings together practicality and distinctive styling in a compact package designed for today's driver who values efficiency and capability.

- Caribbean Blue Metallic exterior with custom ACTIV grille
- Chevrolet MyLink premium audio system with 6 speakers
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Heated front seats and leatherette seat trim
- Body-color manual folding heated outside mirrors
- Roof rack with rails
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Front fog lights
- Exterior parking camera with rear view
- Remote keyless entry with panic alarm
- OnStar emergency communication system
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space

The 1.4L DOHC engine paired with CVT transmission delivers 30 city MPG and 37 highway MPG, making this Spark an economical choice for daily commuting and weekend adventures alike. Front-wheel drive provides confident handling in various driving conditions, while the responsive steering wheel with mounted audio controls keeps you connected to both the road and your entertainment without distraction.

Comfort and convenience are thoughtfully integrated throughout the cabin. Heated front seats warm you on cold mornings, while the air conditioning keeps you cool during warmer months. The 4-way manual driver seat adjuster allows you to find your ideal driving position, and the tilt steering wheel accommodates drivers of different heights. Power windows and door locks operate at the touch of a button, and the illuminated entry system welcomes you with ambient lighting.

Safety is a priority with this Spark ACTIV. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and rear side impact airbags surround you with protection. ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to help you maintain command in challenging driving situations. Low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about your vehicle's maintenance needs, and the remote panic alarm provides additional security.

The exterior reflects the ACTIV's rugged character with black front and rear bumpers, a painted roof-mounted luggage rack, and distinctive styling that sets it apart. The rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers adapt to changing weather conditions, while the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in all seasons.

This 2019 Chevrolet Spark ACTIV represents an excellent value for drivers seeking a reliable, fuel-efficient vehicle with modern conveniences and distinctive styling. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this compact crossover firsthand and discover how it fits your lifestyle.

This 2019 Chevrolet Spark 1LT is a practical and efficient compact car designed for drivers seeking reliable transportation with strong fuel economy.

- 1.4L DOHC engine with CVT transmission
- 30 city / 38 highway MPG
- Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system with AM/FM radio
- SiriusXM satellite radio capability
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- 6-speaker audio system
- Rear parking camera
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- OnStar emergency communication system
- Front fog lights with automatic headlight operation
- Heated power door mirrors with body-color manual folding design
- Remote keyless entry with panic alarm
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- 15" silver painted aluminum wheels with red wheel inserts

This Spark delivers practicality in an easy-to-maneuver package. The 1.4L DOHC engine provides dependable performance while the continuously variable transmission optimizes fuel efficiency for daily driving. Real-world results show 30 MPG in city driving and 38 MPG on the highway, making this vehicle economical to operate.

The interior offers comfort and convenience features that matter. Air conditioning keeps you cool on warm days, while the power windows, power door locks, and remote keyless entry add ease to your daily routine. The tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position, and the trip computer provides useful vehicle information at a glance.

Safety and security are prioritized with multiple airbags including dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist help maintain vehicle control in challenging conditions. The rear parking camera assists with backing up safely, while OnStar provides emergency communication if needed.

The exterior presents a striking red finish complemented by 15" silver painted aluminum wheels with red wheel inserts that add visual appeal. The body-color bumpers and spoiler complete the modern appearance. Heated side mirrors and a rear window wiper contribute to visibility and convenience regardless of weather conditions.

This 2019 Spark 1LT combines affordability, efficiency, and practical features for buyers who value straightforward, dependable transportation. We invite you to schedule a test drive today to experience how this vehicle meets your needs.

Discover practical, efficient transportation with this 2024 Mitsubishi Mirage ES, a compact vehicle designed for everyday driving with an eye toward fuel economy and reliability.

- 1.2L 3-Cylinder DOHC MIVEC engine with CVT automatic transmission
- 7.0" Smartphone-Link Display Audio with Android Auto & Apple CarPlay
- Front-wheel drive with Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Exterior parking camera for rear visibility
- Automatic temperature control with air conditioning
- Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry system
- Split folding rear seats for flexible cargo space
- Speed control and brake assist for enhanced driving convenience
- Front bucket seats with fabric trim
- Power door mirrors and power windows
- ABS brakes with dual front and side impact airbags
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Rear window wiper and defrost

The Mirage ES delivers impressive fuel efficiency with an EPA-estimated 36 city and 43 highway miles per gallon. Whether navigating city streets or traveling longer distances, this vehicle responds predictably and handles well. The fuel-efficient 1.2L engine paired with the CVT transmission strikes a balanced approach to everyday driving needs without compromising practicality.

Inside, the seven-inch display audio system keeps you connected with seamless smartphone integration through Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. Climate control automatically maintains your preferred temperature, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you adjust settings without taking your hands from the wheel. The split rear seats fold down to accommodate larger cargo when needed.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, comprehensive airbag protection across dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead positions, plus low tire pressure monitoring. The rear parking camera provides added confidence when backing up. Brake assist and ABS work together to support confident stopping in various conditions.

The exterior presents a clean, modern appearance with body-color bumpers, power mirrors, and a rear spoiler. Automatic headlights with delay-off functionality enhance visibility and convenience. This Mirage ES represents solid value for buyers seeking dependable daily transportation with proven efficiency and practical features.

Visit our showroom to see this 2024 Mitsubishi Mirage ES and experience how its combination of efficiency, connectivity, and safety features can serve your transportation needs.
